model_annotations.Bulgarian: Тази стълбовидна диаграма илюстрира връзката между степента на разреждане и perplexity за два подхода: Per-Output и Per-Layer. Хоризонталната ос показва степени на разреждане, вариращи от 10% до 80% с интервал от 10%, докато вертикалната ос е етикетирана като Perplexity и има скала от $10^0$ до $10^3$. Всеки подход е представен с различни цветове: Per-Output в синьо и Per-Layer в оранжево. За всяка степен на разреждане са показани два стълба, което позволява визуално сравнение между двата подхода. Стойностите на perplexity за двете групи се увеличават с увеличаване на степента на разреждане. При 10% степен на разреждане стойностите на perplexity са под $10^1$ и за двата подхода. При 80% степен на разреждане стойността за Per-Output e малко над $10^2$, а за Per-Layer са малко над $10^2$.
model_annotations.Chinese:
This bar graph illustrates the relationship between sparsity rate and perplexity for two categories: Per-Output and Per-Layer. The horizontal axis represents the sparsity rate, ranging from 10% to 80% in increments of 10%, with a linear scale. The vertical axis represents perplexity, labeled with values from 10^0 to 10^3, also on a logarithmic scale, with major ticks at 10^0, 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. 

The graph features two sets of bars, one for Per-Output (blue) and one for Per-Layer (orange), at each sparsity rate. At lower sparsity rates (10%-50%), both Per-Output and Per-Layer perplexity values are relatively low and similar, with approximate values around 5-10. As the sparsity rate increases to 60%-70%, perplexity for both categories begins to rise, with Per-Layer showing slightly higher values than Per-Output. At 80% sparsity rate, Per-Output perplexity is approximately 400, and Per-Layer perplexity is slightly higher, around 600. The bars are not sorted in any specific order beyond the increasing sparsity rate, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding and category labeling.
model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the relationship between sparsity rate and perplexity for two categories, Per-Output and Per-Layer. The horizontal axis represents sparsity rate, labeled with percentages from 10% to 80% in increments of 10%, and is on a linear scale. The vertical axis represents perplexity, labeled with values from 10^0 to 10^3 on a logarithmic scale. The chart features two sets of bars, one in blue for Per-Output and one in orange for Per-Layer, plotted at each sparsity rate. The Per-Output bars have approximate values ranging from around 5 at 10% sparsity to around 400 at 80% sparsity. The Per-Layer bars have approximate values ranging from around 5 at 10% sparsity to around 600 at 80% sparsity. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and there is no visual emphasis on any of the bars.
model_annotations.German: Dieses Balkendiagramm stellt den Zusammenhang zwischen Perplexity und Sparsity Rate für zwei Kategorien dar: Per-Output und Per-Layer. Die horizontale Achse zeigt die Sparsity Rate in Prozent, von 10% bis 80% in Schritten von 10%, während die vertikale Achse die Perplexity auf einer logarithmischen Skala von etwa 5 bis 600 darstellt. Die Balken für Per-Output sind blau und die für Per-Layer orange. Bei einem Sparsity Rate von 10% beginnen beide Kategorien bei einer Perplexity von knapp über 5. Mit zunehmender Sparsity Rate steigt die Perplexity für beide Kategorien an, wobei die Per-Layer-Werte bei 70% und 80% Sparsity Rate deutlich höher liegen als die Per-Output-Werte. Der höchste Wert wird bei 80% Sparsity Rate erreicht, wo Per-Output eine Perplexity von etwa 450 und Per-Layer eine Perplexity von etwa 550 aufweist. Die Balken sind nicht sortiert und es gibt keine Hervorhebungen.
